name: KutilXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables: Wave Bard on Bastl's open-source Kastle 2 DSP, plus imagined Kompas, Crust 2, Pizza, Alchemist, Basil and ABC across three panels. Tap a jack then another to patch, cables run between screens, and a tap on empty panel art zooms the top or bottom half of a screen to the full display.
